bullets.text: Musk Denies Grok's Issues - **Elon Musk** claims ignorance over **Grok**'s generation of explicit images as investigations commence.
Netflix Enters Podcasting - **Netflix** launches original video podcasts featuring **Pete Davidson** and **Michael Irvin** to boost engagement.
Google's Gemini Enhancements - **Google**'s **Gemini** app introduces proactive responses by integrating user data across platforms.
Samsung's Refurbished Program - **Samsung** expands its Certified Re-Newed program to the **UK**, promoting sustainability in tech.
Wikipedia Celebrates 25 Years - **Wikipedia** marks its 25th anniversary, showcasing the contributions of its dedicated volunteer editors.
AI Models Solve Math Problems - **OpenAI**'s latest model shows promise in solving complex mathematical problems, pushing AI boundaries.
Bandcamp Bans AI Music - **Bandcamp** prohibits AI-generated music, emphasizing the importance of human creativity in music production.
Tesla Shifts to Subscriptions - **Tesla** will only offer subscriptions for its Full Self-Driving software, ending one-time purchases.
Verizon Resolves Outage - **Verizon** claims to have fixed a major service outage affecting over 2 million customers across the US.
WitnessAI Raises $58M - **WitnessAI** secures funding to enhance security measures for enterprise AI applications.
